files.freesoundName: Mexico City Centro - Sanbornes vs. Jackhammer
files.description:
Listen to the soundscape of one of the central streets in Mexico City. You can hear the easy-listening Sanbornes music playing out onto a street being jackhammered. There is a nice juxtaposition of noise vs. music here.  

Recorded with an Edirol R-09 HR in Mexico City 2010.
files.author: taurindb

files.description: A jackhammer is breaking up walls inside a large building. Sounds recorded from outside the entrance
